Tasks: SWE-bench Verified (500) and SWE-bench Pro Python (242). Configurations: 9 settings x 4 backends, one model (Claude Opus 4.8); 26 cells over 500 instances. Baselines: unaided (row 0), localization-only (row 4). Held constant: scaffold, prompts, 250-step budget, container, sanitized git history, hidden tests never visible. Acceptance tests: hidden SWE-bench tests plus verification and equivalence judges. Repetitions: 1 per cell; Nagini cells 4 (except rows 1, 5). Human intervention: none

Tests incomplete: 26.8 points of test-passing baseline patches overturned by audit (85.0 -> 58.2). Self-written spec does not help: row 2 vs row 0 +0.6 (Nagini) to -1.2. Provided formal spec raises resolution 85.0 -> 94.0-96.2; +6.9 over localization alone; +8.6 to +11.0 over self-written (row 7 vs 3). EARS: resolves like formal (row 2 EARS 421 vs Nagini 428, McNemar p = 0.35) but fails the audit far more (row 3: 286 vs 420 pass, p = 5e-28). Spec synthesis passes audit only 46-61%; faithfulness fails 42.5%. Unresolved instances' specs fail audit 92.3% vs 50.5% resolved. Cost: provided spec cheaper than end-to-end (389k vs 517k input tokens per resolved). Pro: provided spec below localization-only (55.8-59.9 vs 61.2)

Distinguished settings clearly on Verified; repetition SD <= 1.3 points, smaller than Wilson half-widths (1.66-4.37). Limitations stated: verify-implies-resolve rests on audited trust points (axiom soundness, implementation-patch refinement); backend expressiveness required manual modeling for a few instances; a few instances relax non-leakage; spec audit is an LLM panel (evidence, not proof); counterexample audit not applied to prover-accepted submissions, so EARS vs formal audit gap is not like-for-like

Faithful specification synthesis from informal intent is the open problem; trust points (axioms, refinement to Python patch, Python translation for conformance as weakest link); expressiveness limits (names, imports, class identity, process/filesystem effects cannot be specified; 22 Pro tasks refused); LLM auditors as evidence. Single model evaluated (not discussed as a limitation)
